items.exampleEn: I need a new lock for my bike.
items.exampleZh: 我的腳踏車需要一個新的鎖。

items.exampleEn: There is dust everywhere in the old house.
items.exampleZh: 那間老房子到處都是灰塵。

items.exampleEn: The baby's shirt is wet. Can you bring a dry one?
items.exampleZh: 寶寶的上衣濕了，可以拿一件乾的來嗎？

items.exampleEn: Our dog jumped over the fence.
We bought some new furniture for the living room.
items.exampleZh: 我們替客廳買了一些新傢俱。

items.exampleEn: My father drives an electric car.
Put the dirty dishes in the sink.
Turn off the tap when you brush your teeth.
items.exampleZh: 刷牙時要把水龍頭關掉。

items.sentenceEn: Be careful. The floor is still wet.

items.audioEn: The water from the kitchen tap is too hot.
items.audioZh: 廚房水龍頭流出來的水太燙了。

items.sentenceEn: Most of our furniture is made of wood.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的傢俱大多是木頭做的。

items.sentenceEn: Please clean the dust from the bookshelf.
items.sentenceZh: 請把書架上的灰塵擦乾淨。

items.stemEn: I can't open the door. Something is wrong with the ____.
items.stemZh: 我打不開門，門鎖有問題。

items.stemEn: The bathroom ____ is full of dirty water.
items.stemZh: 浴室的洗手檯裝滿了髒水。

items.passageEn: Last month, Peter bought an old house. When he first walked in, the furniture was covered in dust, and the lock on the back door was broken. The kitchen sink had no tap! The fence around the garden was falling down. Now, after a lot of work, the house looks great. He even put electric lights in the garden.
items.passageZh: 上個月，Peter 買了一間老房子。他第一次走進去時，傢俱上全是灰塵，後門的鎖也壞了。廚房的水槽竟然沒有水龍頭！花園四周的圍籬也快倒了。現在，經過一番努力，房子看起來很棒。他甚至在花園裡裝了電燈。

questions.questionZh: Peter 第一次走進房子時看到什麼？
廚房的水槽有什麼問題？

rubricZh: 「還是」可寫例如 still，常放在 be 動詞後面（is still wet）

items.instructionZh: 用 furniture 造一個句子，說說你家的傢俱。
referenceEn: We don't have much furniture in our small apartment.
Our furniture is old, but it is very comfortable.
rubricZh: furniture 是不可數名詞（例如 some furniture、much furniture，不寫 furnitures）
說「一件傢俱」可寫 a piece of furniture

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：「門鎖好像有問題」：原文 Something is wrong with the lock 是肯定語氣，「好像」多加了推測語氣；宜作「門鎖有問題」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "我打不開門，門鎖有問題。"（原 "我打不開門，門鎖好像有問題。"）；刪去原文沒有的推測語氣

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似寫死：「『還是』用 still」未用「例如」；雖然 still 是最常見寫法，依已裁原則應寫成「『還是』可寫例如 still（is still wet）」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "「還是」可寫例如 still，常放在 be 動詞後面（is still wet）"（原 "「還是」用 still，放在 be 動詞後面（例如 is still wet）"）；改成「例如」
